title: Ekonomi Kreatif: Teori dan Praktik
subtitle: Ekonomi Kreatif: Teori dan Praktik
blurb: This book explores Creative Entrepreneurship as a transformative force at the intersection of creativity, innovation, digital transformation, sustainability, and global economic development. Grounded in contemporary entrepreneurship theory and interdisciplinary scholarship, it examines creative business models, digital ecosystems, social impact, institutional challenges, and strategic pathways for building inclusive and sustainable creative economies.
